prereq.note: Only users with the Shelter administrator or Owner role can do this.
Adopter and foster records contain personal information. Share them only with staff who need them, and never export them to personal devices.
saves your changes as you type. The Saved indicator in the top bar confirms each save.
An API key has the same access as the user who created it. Store keys in a secrets manager, never in source code or client-side apps.
Every account includes a sandbox shelter with sample animals. Use a sandbox key (prefix cb_test_) while you build and test your integration.
